body:
My Shamanistic Salvia Undertaking
This is what salvia feels like to me.
I obtained the strongest level of purple sticky (80x) a smoke shop had in California after going through many shops that didn't carry it.
The effects began with me forgetting about my memories. Forgetting about all that accumulates to my awareness of how I exist whether it was any possible religious or scientific or anything other information. I forgot it all. This is the base of the effects. On top of this layer was the dimensions. My reality became my visual field but my reality didn't include anything behind the walls or anything behind anything. A picture reality and everything behind what I saw became a part of a black universe that was never ending and was an infinite amount of black space.
I forgot what and who my friend was for 5 minutes and he become a face I talked to by tunnel vision while everything in the peripherals were unnoticed.
The effects on the body were neither good nor bad. After-effects and low-intensity effects were basically drowsiness and calm and slow contemplation as I slowly got back into reality in about a half hour. I've used small amounts of salvia to just obtain a drowsy state and fall asleep. The higher intensity effects on the body is my asshole feeling like it's the back end of the vision-reality. Behind my asshole encompasses the other side of the entire infinite black space. It feels heavy so I'm usually sitting down or lying down.
If you can imagine an empty universe with a cube room in the middle and you were sitting in that room and your vision in that room became your reality and your asshole became the part of the empty universe, that's what it was like for me.
My state of mood was neither good nor bad. If I was happy earlier in the day I'd lose it and become apathetic and contemplative. If I was bored and had nothing to do that day I would also become apathetic and contemplative.
If I was happy earlier in the day I'd lose it and become apathetic and contemplative. If I was bored and had nothing to do that day I would also become apathetic and contemplative.
I never tried it in a bad mood.
I took salvia because I wanted the 'shamanistic breakthrough experience' and wanted to change my perceptions and attitude in life in positive ways. This was not achieved with using salvia because firstly, I exercise often and salvia lowers my energy. Intensity level required for contemplation is too much and last no longer than an hour leaving me the rest of the day feeling tired. Contemplation was average. Nothing like experiences I've heard of on acid or mushrooms or dmt that make a person experience humility. Contemplations included lots of wondering what I was, what humans were, how humans have simply eaten stuff and reproduced for generations. Shit like this. Nothing mind boggling to someone who exposes themselves to science and questions often.
